name: graphos-agent-mods
description: Experimental Claude Code mods for GraphOS Agent Services. GraphOS Inspector explains each execute call in a docked pane before you approve it, shows what came back with clickable records, and can auto-approve the reads you write trust rules for.

atlassianBase.title: Atlassian site
atlassianBase.description: https URL of your Jira and Confluence cloud site, e.g. https://yourco.atlassian.net; overrides [bases] in links.toml. Empty uses links.toml, and where that names none either, the site is learned from Agent Services responses: a Jira answer shows it in a status's or a priority's icon, so any search that returns status or priority teaches it. A site you set here is never replaced.

gleanBase.title: Glean site
gleanBase.description: https URL of Glean; overrides [bases] in links.toml. Empty uses links.toml.

slackBase.title: Slack workspace
slackBase.description: https URL of your Slack workspace, e.g. https://yourteam.slack.com; overrides [bases] in links.toml. Empty uses links.toml, and where that names none either, the workspace is learned from Agent Services responses (a Slack response that shows it). A workspace you set here is never replaced.

extraLinks.title: Extra links (JSON)
extraLinks.description: JSON array of link templates, e.g. [{"label":"Open in X","service":"x","field":"x_search*","arg":"query","base":"https://x.example","template":"{base}/s?q={value}"}]. base may also be atlassian, glean or slack. Prefer a links.toml override file (/gas links).
